changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE trades ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, trade_ref VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, trade_date DATE NOT NULL, counterparty_id BIGINT NOT NULL, instrument_id BIGINT NOT NULL, side VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, price DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id, trade_date) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (trade_date);
CREATE TABLE trades_y2026m04 PARTITION OF trades FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-04-01') TO ('2026-05-01'); CREATE TABLE trades_y2026m05 PARTITION OF trades FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-05-01') TO ('2026-06-01'); CREATE TABLE trades_y2026m06 PARTITION OF trades FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-06-01') TO ('2026-07-01'); CREATE TABLE trades_y2026m07 PARTITION OF trades FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-07-01') TO ('2026-08-01');
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS trades CASCADE;
